summary: Obsidian Energy filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report) furnishing an operational and guidance update dated September 14, 2026. The company revised 2026 production guidance to 28,500–29,500 boe/d from 29,000–31,000 boe/d, citing wet-weather delays and third-party compressor downtime at the recently acquired Belly River assets, now restored to roughly 2,400 boe/d. It reaffirmed a second-half program with two rigs each in Peace River and Willesden Green, a December exit rate near 31,000 boe/d, and 15%+ 2027 growth. This is routine operational disclosure, not a special situation.
